text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"I got you an extra-special birthday 
present! Its name is—the 'Downtown Healing 
Trip'!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You're always going around comforting 
everyone, aren't ya? Take it easy for 
once.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my...! Hehehe, that's so true. I need 
to be full of energy myself if I want to 
help soothe everyone else~!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! First up is my go-to public 
bathhouse! We'll soak in a mugwort bath 
while gazing at a huuuuge Mt. Fuji!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my~! So nice, warm, and re~laxing 
in the bath. And next... let's go-goâª

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Oh well! Next up is a houseboat! Small 
side dishes and fish on the water, that's 
real Edo-style culture~!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
There, there~! Floating in a little boat, 
munching on tasty food. And then... a full 
belly♪

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"...No, wait a sec. What's with all this 
'go-go' and 'pon-pon' you've been saying? 
What's that about?"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, my apologies. I just got a little 
too excited thinking about our wonderful 
relaxation plan...♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Just chillin' at the public bath... and 
blow-dryin' Inari-chan's hair with a big 
whoooosh.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Patting Inari-chan's tummy on my lap after 
she's completely full from the houseboat 
feast... hehe. I'll soothe you oh so 
much~♡

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"...Hold on! This trip was supposed to 
help you relax, wasn't it?!"
